desc:
🪓 Hire a CREW of Animals to chop down trees — and build your WOOD EMPIRE!
Farm cash while AFK, upgrade your forest, unlock new floors, and roll for insanely rare Animals. 🌲💰

💰 IDLE TYCOON — your Animals keep chopping and earning cash while you’re AFK
🌲 UPGRADE YOUR FOREST — unlock better trees and earn more from every log
🎰 FREE UNLIMITED ROLLS — spin forever and collect rare Animals
⬆️ BUILD NEW FLOORS — expand your empire and unlock more space
⚡ UPGRADE YOUR CREW — chop faster, carry more wood & grow your empire
